job.command:
stardev
# Flatten sim_to_jet/ into the job's working dir (StRoot/ and # .sl73_x8664_gcc485/ stay as-is -- the build system expects those paths). cp sim_to_jet/* . cp shared/* .
if ( "pythia8" == "pythia8" ) then ln -sf starsim_pythia8_filter.C starsim.C set pid = "pythia8" else ln -sf starsim_pythia6_filter.C starsim.C set pid = "pythia6" endif
set seed_temp=`od -vAn -N4 -tu4 < /dev/urandom` set myseed=`expr ${seed_temp} % 100000` set run_number = ${JOBINDEX}
# ptHatMin/ptHatMax for this job (see header comment) set ptcut = 10 set ptcutmax = 15
echo "========================================" echo "Generator = pythia8 (tune/PDF param=3)" echo "ptHatMin = ${ptcut} GeV" echo "ptHatMax = ${ptcutmax} GeV" echo "FcsJetFilter Ethr = 50.0 GeV" echo "EM-only = 1" echo "nevents = 20" echo "Save SimpleTree = 1" echo "JOBINDEX = ${JOBINDEX}" echo "Random seed = ${myseed}" echo "========================================"
mkdir -p /star/data01/pwg/seanp/pipeline_output/em_only_smoketest
echo "Starting detector simulation..."
root4star -q -b starsim.C\(20,${myseed},${ptcut},3,50.0,${ptcutmax}\)
echo "Finished detector simulation."
# Rescue StarPrimaryMaker's end-of-run StarGenStats file (cross # section for this job's ptHatMin/ptHatMax cut, read back by # readMudst.C's ReadMCJobStats()) before runSimBfc.C's own output # file -- which collides on the exact same name, ${pid}.starsim.root # -- silently overwrites it below. ${ptcut}/${ptcutmax} themselves # (the ptHatMin/ptHatMax cut values, not just the resulting cross # section) are passed straight through to readMudst.C below and # recorded on every row as mc_pthatmin_gev/mc_pthatmax_gev. mv ${pid}.starsim.root ${pid}.genstats.root
echo "" echo "Starting reconstruction..."
# Full positional arg list needed so 0 (last param) can # be set -- CINT can't skip earlier args; rest are runSimBfc.C's own defaults. root4star -b -q runSimBfc.C\(20,1,\"${pid}\",202207,0,0,1.5,0.0,\"0.0100\",0,0,input_dir,output_dir,input_chain,0,0\) root4star -b -q readMudst.C\(0,1,\"${pid}.MuDst.root\",\".\",\"\",202209,${ptcut},${ptcutmax}\)
echo "Finished reconstruction."
# Jet finding: JetMatcher takes a list-file arg, so write a one-line list. module purge module load fastjet-3.3.4 module load root-5.34.38
echo "Compiling JetMatcher..." g++ -m64 JetMatcher.cpp VectorDict.cxx -o JetMatcher \ `root-config --cflags --libs` -lEG \ `fastjet-config --cxxflags --libs` -std=c++11
set TRIGGER_FILTER = ""
echo "SimpleTree_mudst.root" > single_file.list
./JetMatcher single_file.list "${TRIGGER_FILTER}" 1 mv jet_output.root jet_output_pythia8_3_pt${ptcut}_${run_number}.root
if ( 1 == 1 ) then mv SimpleTree_mudst.root SimpleTree_pythia8_3_pt${ptcut}_${run_number}.root else rm -f SimpleTree_mudst.root endif
# Temporary, job-local only; never meant to leave scratch. Its # useful content (sigmaGen/nTried) is already baked into every # jetTree/SimpleTree row above via sigma_job/N_job. rm -f single_file.list ${pid}.genstats.root
echo "Files in scratch:" ls -l
